title: Spirit of Orca Whale Watching, Wildlife, & Birding Tours
specs: See orcas, humpbacks, minkes, gray or fin whales, sea lions, seals, porpoises, dolphins, and 172 species of sea birds including bald eagles and tufted puffins
Tours are private for one to six passengers

services.name: Whale Tales
services.desc: “The Sea, once it casts its spell, holds one in its net of wonder forever.” Jacques Cousteau On today’s two tours, we saw minke whales and orcas, the T75Bs. Our first stop was at the rocks to see Ottis, the sea otter, eating green sea urchins. We stopped off to see a pair of marbled murrelets. This little bird is endangered. They fish here and fly about fifty miles inshore to get to their nest. They will only nest in old-growth forests; not much old-growth is left. Then we viewed a minke whale going after bait balls of fish. One of my passengers was doing a report on minke whales. On the way back, we saw tufted puffins but no sign of the horned puffins for

includes: Professional photos of the trip sent by email
Guide knowledgeable about local wildlife and area
blurb: Guests join private tours aboard Spirit of Orca II, a stable catamaran with a walk-around cabin open on three sides. Tours last three or six hours and focus on viewing orcas, other whales, sea lions, seals, porpoises, dolphins, and 172 species of sea birds. Departures are from Anacortes, Washington, avoiding ferry hassles.
extraNote: Viewing guidelines are among the most conservative in the world and adopted into Washington state law · Departing from Anacortes, Washington

quotes.author: Kathryn S
quotes.text: Great day and a wonderful experience. We had a wonderful day, 10am to 1pm, August 28, 2024 with Spirit of Orca and Captain Ken explaining all the wildlife we saw. It took awhile to find a pod of Orcas, but the ride was very scenic and we learned so much. We would recommend this tour to any age, individuals and families. We felt very safe and would definitely go again. This was our second trip with Ken. We received professional photos of our trip that Ken took and sent to our email shortly after the trip. Beautiful! Thank you, Spirit of Orca!

quotes.author: dull2shinetoo
quotes.text: Stunning even in thick fog! We took a morning excursion to the Saltish Sea with Captain Ken. The fog was very thick, yet our experienced, competent captain expertly guided our vessel to and close to a stunning variety of marine and bird wildlife with sufficient pauses for successful photography. I hail from Virginia, and this was my first tour of Puget Sound; my list of newly encountered animals rose significantly! Perfect for small groups, priced reasonably for the intimate view of the special habitat found around those islands.

quotes.author: aldair m
quotes.text: Amazing Experience We had a great time with the guide, He was really knowledgeable and friendly. We appreciated all the accommodations. For the price it was in the midrange. It wasn’t extremely expensive for everything they did. We were able to watch a family of Orcas and 2 Humpback Whales! We hope to come back later one maybe with a little bit more friends or family. 5 Stars all the way!

quotes.author: Tayva B
quotes.text: Exceeded Expectations Captain Ken made this a wonderful experience for our family! He scouted out where the orca pods were the morning of the tour, shared so many fun facts about the sea life in the area, and captured amazing pictures for us! We had no idea we would be getting professional pictures, in addition to the tour. Thanks Ken!

quotes.author: Darpelk
quotes.text: Excellent photography experience We had a group of 6 and focused on getting some quality pictures of orcas and other marine life. We had an excellent experience and it was a perfect setup for a group that size. Highly recommend especially if you are interesting in photography during the trip.

quotes.author: Felicia Y
quotes.text: Orcas in October My family and I had a great time on our tour. Ken was very knowledgeable of the area and its wildlife. We saw orcas, bald eagles, and seals. The boat ride was exciting and Ken provided blankets to help us bare the autumn chill.
